observations: one last sample and one prior action; checked lifetime counters; no in-memory history queue
publication: all required closures verified before immutable remote certificate and fsynced atomic CURRENT2
restore: explicit copy, no fallback, all ancestors/state/progress verified before Kafka; retained operator certificate/hash permits clean-scratch remote-only restore

policy_recovery_and_scores: estimated, not provider billing or hard real-time guarantees
failure_domain: local fsync and real separately running same-host S3 service; no cross-host/AZ/disk-loss guarantee
refused_or_deferred: v1/v2 mixed roots or implicit migration
